categoryStory.mini: Mini cars suit village streets, short island hops, and easy parking near tavernas. Ideal when you want simple island mobility without unused seats.
categoryStory.compact: Compact cars balance everyday comfort with easy parking for couples and small groups exploring Paros and Antiparos in one week.
categoryStory.crossover: Crossovers sit higher for mixed roads, luggage after flights, and coastal drives when you want a little more presence than a compact.
categoryStory.suvs: SUVs bring space and confidence for families, hills, and beach access roads across both islands.
categoryStory.convertible: Convertibles turn coastal days open-top when the wind allows, with the same clear pickup points as the rest of the fleet.
categoryStory.people-carriers: People-carriers seat seven or nine for groups, airport luggage runs, and shared villa weeks without splitting into two cars.
categoryStory.scooters: Scooters make quick paved hops between beach and town, with helmets included and a light footprint in busy harbours.
categoryStory.atvs: ATVs open dirt tracks, quieter coves, and off-main-road exploring when you want more than the asphalt loop.
categoryStory.bikes: Bicycles and e-bikes suit quiet days near the port. Availability is on enquiry so we can match the right set to your dates.

about.story1: It started in 1994 with one car and a simple promise: treat every visitor like a guest, not a customer. Three decades later, AGGELOS Rentals is the only vehicle rental agency headquartered on Antiparos island, and we wouldn't have it any other way.
about.story2: Aggelos and his family have watched this island grow from a quiet backpacker stop to a sought-after Aegean destination. We've served guests from over 60 countries, helped families reach hidden beaches no map shows, and handed the keys of a Suzuki Jimny to Tom Hanks (yes, really).
about.story3: Our fleet has grown to include cars, SUVs, scooters, ATVs, buggies and bicycles, but our philosophy hasn't changed. Personal service. Fair prices. Honest advice. We'll tell you which road to avoid in August and which beach is worth the drive.
about.v1desc: What you see is what you pay. No surprise fees at pickup.
about.v2desc: 30 years of local expertise. We know every road on both islands.
about.v3desc: A real person answers the phone, always Aggelos or family.
about.v4desc: All vehicles serviced before every rental. Helmets always included.

contact.subtitle: We're based at Antiparos Port and available 7 days a week during the season. Call, WhatsApp, or email, we respond fast.
